suppress.comment: removing rows containing values along the following ICD9CM and ICD10CM parent codes using a lookup table for all concept_ids to be suppressed for note_type_concept_id
suppress.on: exists (select * from `:idataset.note` as record2 where note.note_id = record2.note_id and note_type_concept_id in (select concept_id from `:idataset._concept_ids_suppression`))
